conditions.bodyHelp: Optional. Match the current JSON body after earlier rules. Use dot paths and array indexes; no wildcards. Values are typed JSON. Missing differs from null.
conditions.headerHelp: Optional. Match original inbound request headers. Names ignore case; values are exact text. Equality matches any repeated value; inequality requires the header and no equal value.
conditions.expressionHelp: Optional. Return boolean true to run the rule. Supports negative indexes, filters and contains(). Evaluates the current body after earlier rules. Evaluation errors and non-boolean results do not match.

about.title: About GPROXY
about.subtitle: One endpoint for your LLM providers, accounts and applications.
about.description: GPROXY is an open-source, self-hosted LLM API gateway built with Rust. Connect your applications to multiple providers through one API endpoint.

features.protocols: Use OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses, Claude Messages and Gemini APIs, with streaming and direct format conversion.
features.accounts: Pool upstream credentials with token refresh, load balancing and failover.
features.control: Manage access, quotas, usage and costs through the admin console and user portal.

about.openSource: Maintained by Leen Hawk and the community. The gateway is licensed under AGPL-3.0-or-later; see the repository for individual component licenses.

sponsor.description: Help keep GPROXY moving forward through GitHub Sponsors.
sponsor.thanks: Your support helps sustain maintenance, provider compatibility and new features. Thank you for using and supporting GPROXY.
